lastResponse: I found and fixed the bug. ## Root cause The delete logic, the on-disk store, and the tree-view refresh wiring are all correct — I verified end-to-end that after a delete, `getChildren` returns the smaller list. The problem was in how VS Code identifies tree nodes. The tree items in [sessionExplorer.ts](src/sessionExplorer.ts) never set an explicit `TreeItem.id`. Per the VS Code API, when no id is provided, **VS Code auto-generates one from the item's label**. The session node's label is `session.title`. So whenever two sessions share a title — which happens routinely with multi-part saves or re-saving the same chat — they get the **same** auto-generated id.
